Note that the evidence to support a claim for prediction of serious adverse 1388 reactions may require different approaches from that for prediction of effectiveness, if it is 1389 considered unethical to place subjects who are considered more likely to have a serious 1390 adverse reaction in the investigational therapeutic product arm. 1391
